cut: 3D v1 stills (19 Nov, en only). Owner, 19 Nov: 'Top3', 'Go ahead with stills for A, later B'. Device: the archive table. Our own pins go into a map of Finland, each one a data-center project the press has reported; the state's register arrives as a steel card drawer, takes the pins in as cards, shuts under NOT PUBLIC, and slides out one sheet: the summary.
argument: Finland's bill HE 282/2026 would make data centers of 0.5 MW or more register from April 2027; the register would be a non-public picture for the authorities, and the public would get a summary.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word

text.en: Finland plans / to [list] its / data centers.

captions.source: HE 282/2026 vp, government bill on a data center register, submitted 29 Oct 2026 (TEM/valtioneuvosto release; Dawn.fi 30 Oct). Reported (search summaries of the TEM/valtioneuvosto release and the bill page, 19 Nov); the bill text itself not yet read: UNCHECKED.

text.en: Every one over / half a megawatt, / from [April 2027].

captions.source: Notification duty for installed IT power of at least 0.5 MW, smaller ones voluntary; in force 1 Apr 2027 if passed. Reported (search summaries of the TEM/valtioneuvosto release and the bill page, 19 Nov); the bill text itself not yet read: UNCHECKED.

The register is kept by the National Emergency Supply Agency (Huoltovarmuuskeskus) as a non-public situational picture for the authorities. Reported (search summaries of the TEM/valtioneuvosto release and the bill page, 19 Nov); the bill text itself not yet read: UNCHECKED.

The agency would publish a regular summary of the industry's and regions' development, the first by 30 Sep 2027 (reportedly quarterly). Reported (search summaries of the TEM/valtioneuvosto release and the bill page, 19 Nov); the bill text itself not yet read: UNCHECKED.

text.en: The list / is for them. / The [summary], / for you.

captions.source: The station's line on the bill's own split between the register (authorities) and the summary (public). No claim about what the register will contain beyond the reported fields.

tag1.en: OUR PINS: DATA CENTER PROJECTS REPORTED BY YLE, KALEVA, KESKI-UUSIMAA, IISALMEN SANOMAT

tag2.en: BILL HE 282/2026 · IN FORCE 1 APR 2027 IF PASSED · 0.5 MW OF IT POWER OR MORE

tag3.en: KEPT BY THE NATIONAL EMERGENCY SUPPLY AGENCY AS A NON-PUBLIC PICTURE (REPORTED)

tag4.en: THE FIRST PUBLIC SUMMARY DUE BY 30 SEP 2027 (REPORTED)

tag5.en: THE REGISTER IS NOT A PERMIT: NO POWER TO INSPECT OR STOP A PROJECT (REPORTED)

props: Map: Natural Earth 10m (public domain), via ../iceye/geo.json. No logos, no people. The drawer and the summary sheet are invented props; the summary's bars carry no numbers (no summary exists yet). Pin labels name the place and the company or project as reported.

post.en: Finland's bill HE 282/2026: from April 2027, every data center of 0.5 MW or more must register. The register itself would not be public; the public would get a summary, the first by Sep 2027 (as reported). The list is for them. The summary, for you.
